query: For an FCC/BCC high-entropy-alloy protective coating susceptible to progressive plastic deformation during continuous loading, what testable mechanistic hypothesis could explain its creep resistance? Specify the governing factor and rationale, an unspecified controlled comparison that would reveal it, predicted observations relative to the starting baseline, the operating boundaries under sustained stress, supporting prior evidence, and a clear falsification criterion.

generation.hypothesis: The introduction of coherent L12-structured precipitates via aging treatment will enhance the creep resistance of the FCC/BCC high-entropy-alloy coating by creating a strong obstacle to dislocation movement.
generation.material_initial_state: FCC/BCC high-entropy-alloy coating, specifically Al0.1Co1.5CrFeMnNi, in the as-cast state
generation.intervention: Aging treatment at 700°C for 24 hours to introduce coherent L12-structured precipitates
generation.conditions: Continuous loading under sustained stress at 600°C, with a constant stress of 200 MPa
generation.mechanism: The introduction of coherent precipitates will create a strong obstacle to dislocation movement, thereby enhancing the creep resistance of the HEA coating. The precipitate-matrix interface will act as a sink for dislocations, reducing the overall dislocation density and promoting a more stable microstructure.
generation.predicted_outcome: The aged HEA coating will exhibit improved creep resistance, with a reduced steady-state creep rate of at least 30% compared to the baseline as-cast coating, under the same loading conditions.
generation.boundary: Continuous loading under sustained stress at 600°C, with a constant stress of 200 MPa
generation.uncertainty: The actual creep resistance of the aged HEA coating may vary depending on the specific aging treatment conditions and the resulting microstructure.

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the creep resistance of the aged HEA coating with that of the as-cast coating under the same loading conditions.
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the aged HEA coating does not exhibit improved creep resistance compared to the as-cast coating, the hypothesis isn't supported.
